# Nucamp

> Nucamp is a coding bootcamp offering comprehensive training in web development, full-stack development, backend development with Python/SQL, and cybersecurity with focus on modern DevOps, CI/CD, and career transformation.

Nucamp provides bootcamp education and career guidance across multiple technology stacks, emphasizing practical skills in continuous integration/deployment, cloud platforms like AWS, containerization with Docker, and real-world development practices. The platform features student success stories, technical deep-dives, and industry insights from bootcamp graduates and tech leaders.

## Key Topics

- CI/CD
- DevOps
- Python
- JavaScript
- Full-Stack Development
- Backend Development
- Docker
- AWS
- Continuous Integration
- Continuous Delivery
- Coding Bootcamp
- Web Development
- Cybersecurity
- Automated Testing
- Agile Workflows

## DevOps & CI/CD

- [CI/CD in Web Development: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-web-development-fundamentals-cicd-in-web-development-a-beginners-guide): Beginner's guide to CI/CD benefits, practices, and real-world examples.
- [Automating Builds and Tests with CI/CD Tools](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-automating-builds-and-tests-with-cicd-tools): Learn CI/CD automation for builds and tests with Jenkins, CircleCI, and Travis.
- [Integrating CI/CD into Agile Workflows](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-integrating-cicd-into-agile-workflows): Practical guide to implementing CI/CD pipelines in Agile development.
- [Security Practices in DevOps Environments](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-security-practices-in-a-devops-environment): DevSecOps guide covering Kubernetes, CI/CD, and secure deployment.

## Backend Development & Cloud Infrastructure

- [Introduction to Docker and Containerization](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-introduction-to-docker-and-containerization): Comprehensive Docker and containerization guide for backend development.
- [Getting Started with AWS for Beginners](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-getting-started-with-aws-for-beginners): Comprehensive AWS guide covering S3, EBS, SageMaker, and certification.
- [Future of Backend Development](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-back-end-with-python-and-sql-exploring-the-future-of-backend-development): Explore AI integration, microservices, serverless in Python/SQL backend.
- [How Server-Side Scripting Works](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-full-stack-web-and-mobile-development-how-does-serverside-scripting-work): Explore server-side scripting with Python, PHP, JavaScript for dynamic content.

## Web Development & Build Tools

- [Web Development Careers: Comprehensive Guide](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-web-development-fundamentals-exploring-web-development-careers-a-comprehensive-guide): Guide to front-end, back-end, full-stack roles and job growth prospects.
- [Role of Automated Build Tools in Web Development](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-full-stack-web-and-mobile-development-what-is-the-role-of-automated-build-tools-in-web-development): Explore Webpack, Gradle, Gulp and automated build tools for efficiency.

## Cybersecurity

- [Latest Innovations in Cybersecurity Tools](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-cybersecurity-what-are-the-latest-innovations-in-cybersecurity-tools): Discover AI/ML innovations shaping modern cybersecurity threat detection.
- [Career Paths in Cybersecurity](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-cybersecurity-what-are-the-various-career-paths-in-cybersecurity): Explore cybersecurity careers from analyst to CISO roles and pathways.

## Student Success Stories

- [Student Spotlight: Carla Montano](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/student-spotlight-carla-montano): Spanish teacher turned software engineer at Green Mountain Technology.
- [Student Spotlight: Keith Yazdanseta](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/student-spotlight-keith-yazdanseta): Financial consultant turned Associate Solutions Developer at Acxiom.
- [Coding Bootcamp to Developer: David Repasky](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/coding-bootcamp-to-developer-david-repasky): Student success story: React developer career transition via bootcamp.
- [Project Spotlight: Smart Task by Dina Muhic](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/project-spotlight-dina-muhic): React Native task management app project by Nucamp bootcamp student.

## Community & Guidance

- [Google Women Techmakers Program](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/google-women-techmakers-program): Google's Women Techmakers program building community and resources for women.
- [The Bigger Picture](https://www.nucamp.co/blog/biggerpicture): Career advice and bootcamp philosophy from Nucamp leadership.
